interpretation_boundary: These contracts define what each candidate means and what must be bound before POP verification.
A contract definition is not evidence that the mechanism exists, moves as described, maintains contact, or is mechanically acceptable.
No candidate is ranked, preferred, selected, or rejected by this registry.
Unknown dimensions, forces, friction, stiffness, preload, speed, timing, limits, and tolerances remain unresolved or MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED.
The current v43 PRISM solids remain project/FITCHECK proposal geometry; exact current-pose contact does not promote the mechanism to accepted operating geometry.

owner_contract.role: A single carrier or slide owns closure/open/release motion for one or more bottle-support rollers.
owner_contract.owner_binding_requirement: Before POP CAD creation, exact candidate component identity and fixed/moving support ownership must be declared.

motion_contract.open_state: Carrier translated away enough to admit the indexed bottle and preserve neighbor/product-flow clearance.
motion_contract.capture_state: Carrier translated toward the bottle until the required rank-sufficient lateral contact set is established under an explicit maintenance law.
motion_contract.label_transfer_and_wrap_state: Carrier remains in its bounded capture region while required contact is maintained and bottle wrap-axis rotation remains intentionally available.
motion_contract.release_state: Carrier retracts enough to remove capture constraint and restore bottle exit path.

acceptable_law_classes: bounded position control with sourced product variation
contact_maintenance_contract.failure_if: Contact exists only at one static nominal pose or relies on guessed bottle tolerance/preload.

rotation_contract.separation_rule: Carrier normal closure must be modeled separately from tangential belt traction/rotation drive.

reaction_support_contract.path: Bottle normal reaction -> roller(s) -> carrier -> linear guide/bearing -> fixed machine support.
reaction_support_contract.failure_if: Reaction path terminates in floating or unbound geometry.

limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.adjustment: Product-size/position adjustment method must be explicit.
limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.compliance: Optional but if used its attachment, preload, force-displacement law, usable travel, and limits must be bound.

required_pop_observations: three-contact or equivalent rank-sufficient contact maintenance

owner_contract.role: A pivoting arm or carrier owns closure/open/release motion for one or more bottle-support rollers.
owner_contract.owner_binding_requirement: Before POP CAD creation, exact arm/carrier, pivot shaft/bearing, and fixed mount identities must be declared.

motion_contract.open_state: Arm pivoted clear of bottle entry and neighboring product path.
motion_contract.capture_state: Arm pivots toward bottle until required contact geometry is established under an explicit maintenance law.
motion_contract.label_transfer_and_wrap_state: Arm remains within a bounded angular capture region while maintaining required contacts without obstructing wrap-axis rotation.
motion_contract.release_state: Arm pivots away to restore the bottle exit path.

acceptable_law_classes: bounded position control with sourced product variation
contact_maintenance_contract.failure_if: Angular closure reaches only nominal tangent geometry and cannot accommodate variation or maintain contact through the operating interval.

rotation_contract.separation_rule: Pivot closure torque/normal force is distinct from tangential bottle-rotation traction.

reaction_support_contract.path: Bottle normal reaction -> roller(s) -> arm/carrier -> pivot shaft/bearing -> fixed support.
reaction_support_contract.failure_if: Pivot support, shaft, bearing, or mount is not tied to fixed load-bearing geometry.

limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.adjustment: Pivot geometry or support position must provide explicit product-size/position adjustment if required.
limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.compliance: If preload/compliance is used, its torque/force-displacement law, travel, attachments, and retention limits must be bound.

required_pop_observations: swept-volume clearance of arm and rollers
pivot reaction path to fixed support

owner_contract.role: The wrap-belt support assembly owns normal closure/open/release motion while the belt also remains a possible tangential rotation-drive element.
owner_contract.owner_binding_requirement: Before POP CAD creation, exact belt-support body, guide/pivot, pulleys/rollers, drive, and fixed mounting identities must be declared.

motion_contract.open_state: Belt support displaced clear enough for bottle entry and neighboring-product flow.
motion_contract.capture_state: Belt support closes toward bottle against opposing support contacts until required lateral restraint is established.
motion_contract.label_transfer_and_wrap_state: Belt support maintains normal contact while tangential belt motion can drive bottle rotation if separately verified.
motion_contract.release_state: Belt support moves away or sequences clear enough to restore product exit.

acceptable_law_classes: bounded position control with sourced variation
contact_maintenance_contract.failure_if: The belt is assumed to supply both traction and adequate normal closure without separately proving each function.

rotation_contract.separation_rule: Normal closure motion/force and tangential belt velocity/traction must be modeled as separate inputs even if physically supplied by one assembly.

reaction_support_contract.path: Bottle normal/tangential reactions -> belt/support/pulleys -> moving support body -> guide/pivot/mount -> fixed support.
reaction_support_contract.failure_if: Belt tension or closure reactions lack a fixed support path.

limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.adjustment: Support position/tension and product-size accommodation must be explicit.
limits_adjustment_compliance_contract.compliance: If belt elasticity or separate preload is credited, its force-displacement behavior must be sourced or measured.

required_pop_observations: separate normal and tangential functional inputs

live_reference_binding.binding_limit: Presence, fixed/floating state, and current-pose contact do not establish a mate chain, actuator, closure owner, motion law, compliance owner, or maintained-contact behavior.

owner_contract.role: Proposed PRISM carrier/link/arm/roller topology is retained as Candidate A for diagnostic POP work.

motion_contract.current_pose: Capture-like static pose with verified bottle-to-belt and bottle-to-two-roller tangency.

contact_maintenance_contract.current_pose_baseline: Bottle 2 has verified tangency to the driven wrap belt and both support rollers with 93 mm trimmed axial overlap for each pair.
contact_maintenance_contract.failure_if: Current pose is treated as proof of maintained capture.

rotation_contract.separation_rule: Current contact geometry cannot by itself prove that the belt drives bottle rotation or that closure normal force is sufficient.

reaction_support_contract.actuator_envelope_note: FITCHECK_PRISM_ACTUATOR_ENVELOPE_45x35x35_V43-1 is an envelope, not an identified actuator.
reaction_support_contract.failure_if: Floating links/arms/rollers are assumed to transmit reactions to fixed support without a bound joint/mate/bearing chain.

required_pop_observations: define actual closure owner or explicitly re-author topology as a POP hypothesis
prove maintained contact through the chosen state path
bind reaction path into fixed PRISM support geometry
bind or explicitly add a maintenance/compliance law
verify whole-body clearance through reachable motion

owner_contract.role: A spring, elastomer, flexure, pneumatic compliance, counterweight, or equivalent element maintains normal contact after a separate parent mechanism establishes capture.

motion_contract.open_state: Determined by parent mechanism; compliant element must unload or move compatibly.
motion_contract.capture_state: Parent closure brings the system into the compliant working range.
motion_contract.label_transfer_and_wrap_state: Compliance maintains the required contact set through product/process variation.
motion_contract.release_state: Compliance unloads or follows parent opening without trapping the bottle.

contact_maintenance_contract.failure_if: Compliance is credited without a sourced/measured force-displacement law and bounded travel.

rotation_contract.separation_rule: Compliance maintains normal contact only unless an additional tangential drive function is explicitly modeled.

reaction_support_contract.path: Both compliant-element attachment ends and their parent structures must be bound to a closed reaction path.
